description: Pooled random split ('all together'): utterances dealt into 5 groups by session, speaker and class; test one, validate on the next. Speakers and dialogs overlap. Leakage ladder rung E, reported as speaker dependent. The baseline CNN of night 1, unchanged except for the data protocol, with seeds 1 to 5, so it can be set beside the session-out baseline (night 1 and cnn_confirm_1, same configuration and seeds). Part of the split plan of 2026-09-26 (project page 'IEMOCAP protocols and split plan'). One data protocol per sweep. Priority 90: right after cnn_confirm_1. Validation only until a selection file exists.
